verdict.rationale: UKVI's own pages set out a non-resident founder path. The Innovator Founder visa states its eligibility (an innovative business that differs from anything else on the market), exact fees for applying outside the UK, separate out-of-country application flows, a mandatory online application, and settlement after 3 years. Global Talent adds an endorsement or prestigious-prize route, and identity can be verified through the UK Immigration: ID Check app. Missing for 10: no explicit list of acceptable foreign identity documents or credentials, no detail on the Innovator Founder endorsement or document-checklist steps, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
